source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Simple Healthy Recipes, Oklahoma Nutrition Information and Education - ONIE Project

steps.instruction: Place 6 cupcake liners in a muffin pan.
In a mixing bowl, stir 1/2 cup of milk and 1/3 cup of applesauce until blended.
Stir in 1/2 cup of flour, 1/2 cup of oats and 1 cup of sugar.
Stir in 1/2 tablespoon of baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon.
Mix until just moistened, without over mixing.
Gently stir in 1 chopped tart apple.
Spoon the batter into the cupcake liners.
Bake for 15 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
steps.spoken: Bake for 15 to twenty minutes, until a toothpick put in the middle comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Cool in the pan for 5 minutes before serving.
Store unused muffins in an airtight container.
